title: Photo Web Hosting Settings
description: Configuration for publicly available image hosting and SFTP upload for KML publishing.

hostname.title: Hostname
hostname.description: Your hosting server's Fully Qualified Domain Name (FQDN).

local_ip.title: Local IP Address
local_ip.description: IP address used for SFTP connection; overrides hostname if specified.[cite: 3]

username.title: Username
username.description: Username for authentication with the hosting server.[cite: 3]

password.title: Password
password.description: Password for authentication with the hosting server.[cite: 3]

hostkey_type.title: Hostkey Type
hostkey_type.description: Hostkey type for known hosts authentication (e.g., 'ecdsa-sha2-nistp256').[cite: 3]

hostkey.title: Hostkey
hostkey.description: Hostkey for authentication with the hosting server.[cite: 3]

upload_protocol.title: Upload Protocol
upload_protocol.description: Currently only SFTP protocol is supported.[cite: 3]

upload_dir.title: Upload Directory
upload_dir.description: Remote directory on the hosting server where photos will be uploaded.[cite: 3]

sftp_dest_fmt.title: SFTP Destination Format
sftp_dest_fmt.description: Format string for generating the SFTP file destination. {photo_path} is required.[cite: 3]

http_dir.title: HTTP Directory
http_dir.description: HTTP subdirectory where images are hosted.[cite: 3]

url_fmt.title: URL Format
url_fmt.description: Format string for generating the hosted image URL. Normally starts with http://.[cite: 3]
